text:
lina: Heads up — proposing go/no-go for v3.4 cut on Tue Apr 12 14:00 UTC. Can people confirm stakeholder coverage? Draft agenda below. Ping your backups.

rob: 14:00 UTC works for me. I'll cover infra and canary owner.

megan: I'll be on PTO Apr 12. @alicia can you stand in for QA?

alicia: Yep I can. Also two items to add: migration rollback runbook + perf regression check.

samir: Can we shift to 15:00 UTC? I have a customer meeting at 14:30.

jason: Prefer 14:00 — we need overlap with APAC. Can you only move 30m?

product-ops: We should keep 14:00. APAC coverage is limited after 15:00.

lina: Ok keeping 14:00. @megan thanks, @alicia noted. Agenda below.

lina: ```
Agenda (draft):
1) Roll call & stakes (5m)
2) CI / canary status (10m) — owner: rob
3) QA smoke & migration check (15m) — owner: alicia
4) Perf/regression summary & fallback plan (10m) — owner: megan (or delegate)
5) Go/no-go vote + contingency (5m)
6) Post-cut verification owners + postmortem cadence
```

deploy-bot: Meeting created: https://calendar.example.com/event/abc123 (host: lina) :calendar: 

rob: Added canary health snapshot: https://kibana.example.com/app/dashboards/canary-v3.4

megan: I'll send perf baseline and regression checklist before EOD Mon.

alicia: I can run a migration rollback dry-run Tue 09:00 UTC and share notes.

samir: I'll mark tentative; if we must keep 14:00, I'll rearrange.

lina: Please react :thumbsup: if attending, :eyes: if tentative. I'll close RSVPs by Mon 18:00 UTC.

jason: :+1:

product-ops: Also suggest we add 'fallback model variant + routing policy' to item 4 and name an owner.

lina: Noted — added. Final agenda & meeting notes will be posted in the calendar event.

rob: Quick note — can we call out who owns the post-cut smoke endpoints? I'd like to pre-assign.

alicia: I'll own /smoke/login and /smoke/api-check.

megan: I'll own throughput perf checks and latency dashboards.

lina: Great. Thanks all — I'll follow up with final attendee list and attach the runbook.
